inputs.label: Set maximal display precision in decimal points: 1

notes: To make simple unit conversions, select the starting units with the pull-down selector on the right. Then type a starting value in the top FROM input box. To convert the value, choose the new unit in the lower right selector. The converted value will appear immediately in the TO box.

Helpful Tips Conversion factors gram X 1e-03 = kilogram microgram X 1e-09 = kilogram milligram X 1e-06 = kilogram nanogram X 1e-12 = kilogram ounce (avoirdupois) X 2.83495231e-02 = kilogram pound (US)
content.data_input_disclaimer: ONLY DIGITS 0 TO 9 AND A SINGLE DECIMAL POINT (".") ARE ACCEPTABLE AS NUMERIC INPUTS. ATTEMPTED INPUT OF OTHER CHARACTERS INTO A NUMERIC FIELD MAY LEAD TO AN INCORRECT RESULT.
